correctness.rationale: The exact quadratic empirical-process decomposition yields one diagonal covariance and one degenerate two-sample kernel covariance. Explicit integration gives diagonal covariance 1/18 and cross-kernel integral 1/18, hence (2n-1)/(18n); the same decomposition yields both stated variances. The limiting correlation follows algebraically. Numerical replay independently recomputes the six integrals.

value.rationale: Cramér–von Mises and Anderson–Darling are canonical companion EDF goodness-of-fit tests. The exact cross-covariance quantifies their redundancy at finite n, and the limiting correlation near 0.979 shows that their null fluctuations remain strongly aligned despite radically different tail weights. This is a natural joint calibration quantity not supplied by the separate marginal moment formulas.
